hyperedges.label: Single v* tag drives client releases and server image

nodes.label: graphify query
nodes.rationale: Use graphify query first for repo architecture, structure, component, or code modification questions when graphify-out/graph.json exists.

nodes.label: Default Android Studio Launcher Branding
nodes.rationale: Both launcher icons are the unmodified Android Studio template artwork: the green Android robot (bugdroid) silhouette on a light-green grid background with a drop shadow. They are shipped at five density buckets (mdpi, hdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi) for square/adaptive and round shapes. This indicates the Android client has not yet been given custom app branding/iconography.

nodes.label: Generate the Hikari Windows client icon.  Draws the 光 ("hikari" — light) glyph
nodes.norm_label: generate the hikari windows client icon.  draws the 光 ("hikari" — light) glyph

nodes.label: versionCode = major*10000 + minor*100 + patch
nodes.rationale: Derived from the tag's numeric core so versionCode increases monotonically and is reproducible; minor/patch capped at 99, Android range 1..2100000000; 10# prefix avoids octal parse of zero-padded parts.

nodes.label: Opt-in APK signing (ANDROID_KEYSTORE_* secrets)
nodes.rationale: Job still succeeds without the keystore secret and publishes an unsigned APK, so CI never blocks on missing secrets.

nodes.label: termux image flavour (linux/arm64, arm/v7, -termux suffix)
nodes.rationale: SDK stage cross-compiles so no QEMU needed; per-flavour GHA cache scope so builds don't evict each other's layers.

nodes.label: Image tag scheme (latest/sha on main, semver on tags)
nodes.rationale: latest=false disables implicit latest on semver tags so latest always tracks main.
nodes.norm_label: image tag scheme (latest/sha on main, semver on tags)

nodes.label: Opt-in Authenticode signing with timestamp retry
nodes.rationale: Timestamp servers are flaky and a missing timestamp makes the signature expire with the cert, so retry up to 3 times rather than skip.
nodes.norm_label: opt-in authenticode signing with timestamp retry

nodes.label: Windows numeric file version (a.b.c.0, parts <= 65534)
nodes.rationale: Windows file versions must be purely numeric 16-bit fields, so pre-release suffix lives only in the product version.

nodes.label: Unit tests gate (Category!=Integration)
nodes.rationale: Integration tests hit the hosted server; a release must not depend on its uptime.

nodes.label: Cross-platform ContentPlugin contract
nodes.rationale: Same contentType string, metadata keys and storage path layout on server, Android and Windows; a new plugin adds a type with no core code changes.

nodes.label: Presigned URL direct-to-storage transfer
nodes.rationale: Bytes flow device<->object storage directly; the sync server only moves metadata.

nodes.label: Offline-first sync with mirrored storage layout
nodes.rationale: Synced files mirror the server key layout so existing players/readers/galleries see them natively.
nodes.norm_label: offline-first sync with mirrored storage layout

nodes.label: Independently pluggable metadata DB and object store
nodes.rationale: No vendor lock-in: pair cheapest object store with most convenient metadata store, or self-host MongoDB + MinIO.
nodes.norm_label: independently pluggable metadata db and object store

nodes.label: Built-in content types (audio, video, book, manga, image)
nodes.norm_label: built-in content types (audio, video, book, manga, image)

nodes.label: ContentSyncService (Android)
nodes.rationale: Streams downloads into the file via a writer instead of ByteArray; buffering whole items caused OutOfMemoryError on large files.

nodes.label: Selection (syncIds) vs local state (syncIndex)
nodes.rationale: Selected-but-not-downloaded items must never look synced; syncIndex is shared across plugins so entries are scoped by the contentType/ prefix.

nodes.label: Release network_security_config (no domain-config)
nodes.rationale: Ktor CIO uses the two-arg checkServerTrusted which Android's RootTrustManager rejects when any per-domain config exists, breaking all HTTPS in release builds.

nodes.label: HIKARI_KEYSTORE_* signing env vars
nodes.rationale: Off-CI release falls back to debug key to stay installable; on CI it is left unsigned rather than signed with a throwaway runner key.

nodes.label: Database:Provider (DynamoDb or MongoDb)
nodes.rationale: Only the selected backend's client is constructed, so MongoDB+MinIO needs zero AWS config; Mongo collection names mirror DynamoDB tables for schema compatibility.

nodes.label: JWT bearer auth with refresh tokens
nodes.rationale: Startup guard rejects signing keys shorter than 32 bytes.
nodes.norm_label: jwt bearer auth with refresh tokens

nodes.label: OBJECT_STORAGE_PUBLIC_SERVICE_URL
nodes.rationale: Presigned URLs embed the signing host; when server reaches MinIO internally but clients use another host, sign with the client-reachable URL.

nodes.label: SMB/CIFS-backed MinIO volume
nodes.rationale: Gated on SMB_HOST so default stack is unchanged; MongoDB kept local by default because WiredTiger is unsupported on network filesystems.

nodes.label: Running on Android via Termux + udocker
nodes.rationale: Avoids paying for cloud compute; stock Android can't run Docker without root, so udocker runs OCI images via proot.
nodes.norm_label: running on android via termux + udocker

nodes.label: ContentPluginBase
nodes.rationale: ResolveInsideLibrary rejects paths escaping the library root as defence against hostile server metadata.

nodes.label: Streaming transfers with .part staging + atomic rename
nodes.rationale: Multi-gigabyte files never buffered in memory; interrupted downloads never look complete.
nodes.norm_label: streaming transfers with .part staging + atomic rename

nodes.label: DPAPI-encrypted token storage
nodes.rationale: Android DataStore is app-private; a Windows file is not, so JWT and refresh token are encrypted per user.

nodes.label: LibraryAccess write-probe
nodes.rationale: Windows has no storage permission prompt, so the client proves write access on launch and before disk ops.

nodes.label: ThemeManager (4 palettes + system accent override)
nodes.rationale: Mutates shared brushes in place so pages repaint instantly; overrides OS accent so the app never looks half-themed.
